authority: saved runtime PE/metadata static scoped Ghidra; no current game execution, no REA retained Evidence ID

rules.level: GuildRaidRoomData.SetCurrentHpCount(byte n) -> CurrentLevel=max(40,n*4). ReceiveBossSymbolData currentHpGauge &255 similarly sets CurrentLevel; GuildRaidLevel is independent short max(40,maxHpGauge*4). Constructor stores the supplied Level without further scaling.
rules.def: base=trunc(f32(f32(i32(rawDef*Level))*0.009999999776482582)); raw multiplication is signed i32 BEFORE f32. Then property40 Def collection applies trunc(f32(f32(f32(1+rate)*f32(base))+f32(constant))); then adds registered living parts; then buff/status changes.
rules.mdef: same as DEF with rawMdef and property40 Mdef collection.
rules.necessaryHit: trunc(f32(f32(f32(f32(Level)*1.5f)*f32(rawHit))*0.009999999776482582)); then property40 NecessaryHit collection then living parts sum.
rules.physicalResistance: rawCutAttack + i32(Level/10) + sum(registered nondead part bodyCut physical correction). No direct property40 or type32 check in this getter.
rules.magicalResistance: rawCutMagicAttack + i32(Level/10) + sum(registered nondead part bodyCut magical correction). No direct property40 or type32 check in this getter.
rules.criticalResistance: Generic MobPropertyCriticalResist.GetCriticalResist reads first type6 property Values[0]; no GuildRaid/level/type40 adjustment in this generic function. Runtime status/buffs can reduce it. Guild status.Get_Property returns merged own+server property manager.
rules.propertyOrder: Guild InitializeMobProperty adds original master properties first, server random-property array afterwards.
rules.serverBonuses: GetMobGuildRaidBonus uses server random-property Id/Lv/Flag list and GuildRaidLevel. Id201 adds property6, Id202/203/204 add property40 Def/Mdef/NecessaryHit constants from GuildRaidLevel*randomLv; exact current server selection absent.
rules.parts: Guild action manager constructs ordinary MobPartsStatus(master,hp,roomDifficulty), not HighRaidMobPartsStatus. Base part getters use ordinary difficulty multipliers. Delegates return zero for IsDead Hp==0, otherwise part getters; cut delegates sum part.bodyCut. Room difficulty0 has not been proven in this pass; future guild part target values must be unresolved rather than applying HighRaid level scaling. Current six primary families have no parts.
rules.hp: Requires hpGage n stored separately from Level at +0x50; raw master MaxHp not used. x=i32(n*4); a=trunc(f32(f32(f32(i32(x*x))/f32(2.4))+f32(x+81))); b=f32(f32(f32(x)/10)+30); c=f32(f32(a)*b); q=Math.Round(double(f32(f32(i32(n*n))/100f)),2,MidpointRounding.ToEven); HP=trunc((q+50d)*double(c)). All q in n0..255 independently checked equal n*n/100 double.
rules.hpFromLevel: Only Level>=44 divisible4 permits n=Level/4 via CurrentLevel path. Level40 corresponds n0..10, so HP cannot be chosen uniquely. Formula exceeds signed i32 at n132 (Level528); do not claim valid positive HP above that boundary.
rules.progression: CurrentHpCount/MaxHpGauge are received from server symbol/synchronization data; updated held-data MaxHpCount is copied from server held objects. Bounded inspected client paths establish count->level, not a universal clearCount->nextMaxHpCount increment.

limitations: No game process access or active gameplay observed.
No current guild/server random-property selection captured; default target is explicitly an unmodified static scenario.
Actual game entry cap and per-success increment schedule are not established; byte representability is not a game cap claim.
HP depends on remaining HP gauge count, distinct from maximum raid level; level40 is ambiguous.
Ordinary room difficulty for future guild part records remains unresolved.
Integer overflow outside relevant safe ranges must not be extrapolated as positive stats.
